title: Claim List Record
description: A single claim extracted from an outline tree via the claim-list render target (FR-018). One record per emitted claim.

claim.description: The claim text extracted from the source outline node.

modality.description: The epistemic/deontic status of the claim. 'assertion' is unqualified; 'epistemic_hedge' marks likelihood/certainty qualification; 'deontic_hedge' marks obligation/permission (MUST/SHOULD/MAY).

polarity.description: Whether the claim is affirmative or negative. Mirrors the 'negation' gold-fact category.

source_span.description: Character offset and quoted text identifying the source of this claim in the original document.

start.description: Character offset (0-indexed) of the start of the claim in the source.

end.description: Character offset (exclusive) of the end of the claim in the source.

text.description: The quoted text at source_span[start:end], for verification.

parent_id.description: Stable identifier of the emitting node's parent in the outline tree. Must be identical across re-renders of an unchanged outline.
